sources.entry: MagicaVoxel - Free, lightweight 8-bit voxel editor and interactive path tracing renderer.

summary.name: MagicaVoxel
summary.one_liner: MagicaVoxel is a free, lightweight GPU-based editor for 8-bit voxel art that also includes an interactive path tracing renderer.
use_cases: building voxel scenes with multiple objects
animating voxel models frame by frame
rendering high-quality images of voxel models
exporting voxel models as meshes or slices
summary.what_it_does: ["A GPU-based voxel art editor with a model editor and a world (scene) editor for arranging multiple objects, groups, and layers.", "Includes brushes, selection tools, a palette with multi-color selection, and a console command system for editing voxels.", "Supports frame-based animation, with animation rendering and turntable rendering to image sequences.", "Includes an interactive path tracing renderer with materials such as metal, plastic, glass, cloud, and SSS, plus camera, lens, and denoiser options.", "Imports and exports files including .vox and mesh/slice/cube/point cloud formats, and provides a Voxel Shader system for procedural voxel generation."]
notable: Interactive path tracing renderer with unified materials (metal, plastic, glass, cloud, SSS) and Intel Open Image Denoiser support
Voxel Shader scripting for procedural voxel generation and animation
Frame-based animation with key frames and turntable/animation rendering
Free for any project, but selling or redistributing the software in other packages is disallowed
caveats: Redistribution or selling the software (original or modified) is disallowed
Windows may require Visual C++ runtime DLLs (VCOMP140.DLL, VCOMP100.DLL) to be installed
macOS may need security settings adjusted to open the app; renderer may show black screen depending on GPU and driver
Some older release notes mention limitations (e.g., 0.99.5 noted pure ray casting for editor), and the renderer requires capable GPU hardware
